testcase.name: Scenario: move-06 Enter a precise ellipse Move endpoint: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/move/scenario.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: move-06 Enter a precise ellipse Move endpoint ✔ Given an editable sketch with eligible geometry ✔ Given the ellipse is selected in Move with Copy off and Precise Input on ✔ When the user chooses Base Point and clicks its center ✔ Then the coordinate toolbar appears and the status requests an endpoint ✔ When the user types 1 then 0 into X and presses Tab to Y ✔ And the user types 0 and presses Enter ✔ Then Move returns to geometry selection without an error dialog ✔ And the ellipse appears above its original position ✔ When the user clicks Done ✔ Then Move closes and the displaced ellipse remains
